name: @maximopay/node
description: SDK oficial do Máximo Pay para Node.js: cobranças, saques e webhooks assinados.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.cjs.json && tsc -p tsconfig.esm.json && tsc -p tsconfig.types.json && node scripts/package-markers.js
scripts.test: npm run build && rm -rf build-test && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test build-test/test/*.test.js
